preservation_limits: This index exports paths, hashes, sizes and sanitized claims only, not raw receipt contents.
Ignored .tools and infra/cdk.out files depend on this local machine; another checkout will not contain them automatically.
Index references do not authorize raw Billing, AWS metadata, screenshot, credential-helper or log publication.
Hashes detect changed bytes; they do not authenticate the provider or prove no later remote drift.
The latest hosted artifact is receipt-backed, not a retained downloadable archive here.
CI artifact metadata describes finite historical retention, not permanent availability.
No external evidence copy, commit or push was performed; archival/publication requires privacy and auto-build-impact review.
This index deliberately excludes its own digest and the later validation receipt to avoid circular hashes.
